description: Assign an existing role to a member. Requires the Manage Roles permission, and the role must be below the bot's highest role. Idempotent: assigning a role the member already has has no effect. Use discord_remove_role to undo.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

role_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the role to assign.

user_id.description: Discord user ID (snowflake) of the member to give the role to.

name: discord_add_role
